- www.aurionpro.com Senior Git Lab Administrator Dev Sec Ops Engineer Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Senior Git Lab Administrator Dev Sec Ops Engineer with strong expertise in Git Lab administration, CICD automation, and Dev Sec Ops practices. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience installing, configuring, upgrading, securing, and maintaining enterprise Git Lab environments while enabling secure and efficient software delivery. Azure Cloud experience is preferred. Primary Skill Git Lab Administration Secondary Skill Azure Cloud Key Responsibilities Git Lab Administration Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain Git Lab Community and Enterprise Ultimate environments. Manage Git Lab Runners, repositories, user access, permissions, groups, and project structures. Configure and maintain repository mirroring and synchronization across Git Lab instances. Perform performance tuning, monitoring, troubleshooting, and capacity planning for Git Lab infrastructure. Support repository migrations from legacy source control platforms as required. Manage Git Lab upgrades, patching, and platform health to ensure platform stability and reliability. CICD Dev Sec Ops Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-scale Git Lab CICD pipelines. Develop reusable pipeline templates and deployment automation frameworks. Integrate security, quality, and compliance checks into CICD workflows. Support Docker-based build and deployment environments. Collaborate with Development, QA, Infrastructure, and Security teams to implement Dev Sec Ops best practices and improve software delivery. Cloud Infrastructure Work with Azure services for hosting and managing Git Lab and Dev Ops infrastructure. Support containerized environments using Docker and related technologies. Exposure to Infrastructure as Code Terraform or Cloud Formation is an added advantage. Required Skills Strong expertise in Git Lab administration and Git Lab CICD. Experience managing Git Lab Runners and Docker executors. Experience integrating and administering SAST, DAST, Dependency Scanning, Container Scanning, and Code Quality within Git Lab CICD pipelines. Strong understanding of Git workflows, branching strategies, repository management, and release processes. Strong scripting skills using Shell andor Python for automation. Knowledge of Dev Sec Ops principles and secure software delivery practices. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Preferred Skills Experience with Git Lab Geo Replication. Experience implementing Backup, Recovery, Disaster Recovery DR, and High Availability HA strategies for Git Lab. Experience with Azure cloud services. LDAP and SMTP integration with Git Lab. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. What We Are Looking For A highly skilled Git Lab Administrator with strong Dev Sec Ops expertise. Experience supporting enterprise-scale Git Lab environments across multiple applications and development teams. Passion for automation, platform reliability, security, and continuous improvement. Ability to work collaboratively across Development, Infrastructure, QA, and Security teams.
